**Frame-path:** NOT_FOUND  
**Call frequency:** UNKNOWN (no static path from tick root)

| this | 0x24 | RW | 0 | first node pointer (zeroed after cleanup) |
| this | 0x28 | RW | 0 | list head field 2 (zeroed after cleanup) |
